maintenance.title: Machine care and maintenance
maintenance.subtitle: Machines · daily operator checks, repair requests, spares and oil
maintenance.requestsSub: from operator checks and staff · each with the machine or mould

colSub.new: from a ✗ on a daily check, or raised here
colSub.waiting_parts: spares or a purchase request awaited
colSub.done: this month · hours down and cost recorded

daily.title: Daily check
daily.body: Operators tick the same points every day on their phone. A ✗ opens an urgent repair request here.

planned.title: Planned care
planned.schedules: Weekly, monthly or by hours: the services listed under Planned care schedules, each with its next due date.
planned.moulds: Moulds: service by shot count, done by the mould department.

sch.title: Planned care schedules
sch.emptyBody: Add the regular services (greasing, oil and filter change, heater check) so each machine shows its next due date.

raise.title: Report a breakdown or repair
raise.hint: A breakdown puts the machine on repair until the request is closed; the downtime runs from the time it broke down.
raise.breakdownHint: Counts downtime from the time below until it runs again.

det.title: Repair request {{no}}
det.cancelEffect: Cancels {{no}}. The history stays; nothing is deleted.
det.noSpares: No spares issued for this request.

spares_.title: Issue spares for {{no}}
spares_.hint: The spares leave the chosen stores through the stock ledger; the server refuses more than is in stock.
spares_.fill: Choose the stores and add at least one item with a quantity above zero.

close.title: Close {{no}}
close.hint: The server works out the downtime from the breakdown time to the time it runs again, and puts the machine back to active.
